summary: Phase 149O.20L.7D.1 -- Dell GitHub Read-Only Deployment Credential Provisioning. Provisioned the narrowly scoped source-access prerequisite that blocked Phase 149O.20L.7D at Action 6, without retrying the nine-action Class-B plan. Re-verified at entry: 149O.20L.7D's rollback was bit-for-bit clean (pcae user/group, all target paths, and both packages independently reconfirmed absent; no root or codex SSH github.com material existed). Reconstructed the immutable Action-6 secret boundary from the pinned f9e33232c83163aad5e50bc94db7cab51b844ac5 object (via git show, not the working tree): the frozen clone command (sudo git clone --no-checkout git@github.com:atimad/pcae-harness.git /opt/pcae/runtime/src) contains no identity flags, and the proposition explicitly disclosed key provisioning as a separate, out-of-scope admin-channel concern. Adjudicated Outcome A (anticipated external prerequisite, not a material Action-6 plan change): a dedicated key plus ambient SSH identity-resolution configuration changes only which key root's SSH client resolves, not the command text, URL, pinned SHA, or target. Generated a fresh Ed25519 keypair at /root/.ssh/pcae_harness_deploy_ed25519 (root:root 600, no passphrase -- required for Action 6's unattended sudo execution, compensated by root-only filesystem access and GitHub-side repository-scoped read-only authority) and registered it via the GitHub API as a read-only deploy key on atimad/pcae-harness (read_only: true, id 160313031, verified: true). Established github.com host trust from GitHub's own published api.github.com/meta endpoint (not trust-on-first-use) into /root/.ssh/known_hosts, and added a Host github.com / IdentitiesOnly yes stanza to /root/.ssh/config for deterministic identity selection. Verified read-only: ssh -T git@github.com confirmed single-repository scope ("Hi atimad/pcae-harness!"); git ls-remote succeeded; the pinned commit 7a3fa971304521cdcb44251e07ef1966baec686a was fetched into a disposable bare repo under /tmp (never the production target), confirmed reachable via FETCH_HEAD, then rm -rf'd and reconfirmed absent. No test push was attempted; write-access-disabled proof is GitHub's own read_only: true API field. Zero Class-B provisioning actions executed this phase; pcae/etc-pcae/opt-pcae/var-lib-pcae/var-log-pcae/home-pcae all reconfirmed absent at close. No DeploymentBinding, HMIC certification, or HATP activation created. No src/pcae/**, docs/contracts/**, or scripts/** file modified. New, independently authored companion test module -- 18 tests, re-run three consecutive times, 18 passed each run, no flake -- covering rollback reconfirmation, dedicated key path/metadata (never bytes), fingerprint, deterministic identity selection, authoritative known_hosts sourcing, repository/pinned-SHA readability, read-only evidence, absence of Class-B/DeploymentBinding/Boundary-C/A state, and secret-leakage grep across tracked files. Source-access prerequisite: PROVISIONED. Dell Class-B infrastructure: NOT PROVISIONED. Dell Boundary P: independently verified authorization retained, fresh execution-entry validation required at 7D.2 entry. DeploymentBinding/Boundary C/Boundary A: NOT AUTHORIZED. HATP: NOT READY. Runtime unchanged (Observed/observe/unavailable). CHGR chgr-96a0ce12756e4cc892492a87af1db832 remains current, subject to fresh 7D.2 entry checks (not independently consumed by this phase). Recommends exactly one next phase: 149O.20L.7D.2 -- the real nine-action retry, not combined with this phase. No certification. No activation. Stops here.
